mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate and increases equity valuation multiples, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a shift to monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and simultaneously the core inflation rate is accelerating (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), the market perceives a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 225.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, the economy is in a recessionary regime, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 500.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0 (indicating a supply shock) and core inflation rises above 225.0, the market experiences stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90.0 and CPIAUCSL > 225.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 13400.0 billion dollars (annualized) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 13400.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) is a persistent indicator of economic weakness, and the labor market condition is always active as a predictor of negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
